rollout_memory_pressure.purpose: Repair genuine rollout memory pressure without treating the phase with the largest relative peak as an automatic bottleneck.
required_evidence: Use this strategy only when generate_sequences failed with an allocation or KV-cache OOM, the measured rollout peak reaches the active stage memory limit, or the memory estimator rollout upper_bound_pct crosses that limit with elevated risk.
For MEMORY_HEADROOM_EXCEEDED, require training_substage=rollout or direct rollout-phase evidence.
insufficient_evidence: resource.memory_bottleneck=rollout by itself; that field only identifies the largest measured phase peak.
Rollout has the highest phase memory but remains comfortably below the active memory limit.
ordered_actions: Decrease actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization only when rollout-engine or KV-cache reservation is the demonstrated source of pressure.
Decrease actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_batched_tokens when the active scheduler token batch creates the peak; this cap has no effect when it is not reached.
Decrease actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_seqs when concurrent runnable sequences create the peak; this cap has no effect when it is not reached.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size only when model or KV sharding is required for feasibility and the added generation communication is acceptable.
do_not: Do not change fixed workload or profile parameters.
Do not combine rollout repair with unrelated actor or ref tuning.
Do not describe a memory reduction as a throughput improvement until a real trial confirms end-to-end throughput.

actor_logprob_memory_pressure.purpose: Repair genuine actor old-log-prob memory pressure in the actor_log_prob phase.
required_evidence: Use this strategy only when compute_log_prob failed with OOM, the measured actor_log_prob peak reaches the active stage memory limit, or the memory estimator actor_log_prob upper_bound_pct crosses that limit with elevated risk.
For MEMORY_HEADROOM_EXCEEDED, require training_substage=actor_log_prob or direct actor_log_prob evidence.
insufficient_evidence: actor_log_prob has the highest relative peak but remains comfortably below the active memory limit.
ordered_actions: When actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz is false, decrease actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu first and validate the installed backend's local batching constraints.

Enable actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.sequence_parallel only when actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size is greater than one, long-sequence activation pressure is credible, and backend support is known.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size only when sharding headroom is needed and world-size divisibility remains valid.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size only as a later feasibility control when lower-overhead controls cannot fit the actor model.
do_not: Do not treat actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu as authoritative when dynamic batching controls the phase.
Do not change actor topology without revalidating data-parallel size and PPO mini/micro batching.
Do not combine actor_log_prob repair with unrelated rollout or ref tuning.

ref_logprob_memory_pressure.purpose: Repair genuine reference log-prob memory pressure in the ref_log_prob phase.
required_evidence: Use this strategy only when compute_ref_log_prob failed with OOM, the measured ref_log_prob peak reaches the active stage memory limit, or the memory estimator ref_log_prob upper_bound_pct crosses that limit with elevated risk.
For MEMORY_HEADROOM_EXCEEDED, require training_substage=ref_log_prob or direct ref_log_prob evidence.
insufficient_evidence: ref_log_prob has the highest relative peak but remains comfortably below the active memory limit.
ordered_actions: When actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz is false, decrease actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu first and validate the installed backend's local batching constraints.

Enable actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.sequence_parallel only when actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size is greater than one, long-sequence activation pressure is credible, and backend support is known.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size only when sharding headroom is needed and world-size divisibility remains valid.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size only as a later feasibility control when lower-overhead controls cannot fit the reference model.
do_not: Do not treat actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu as authoritative when dynamic batching controls the phase.
Do not change ref topology without revalidating its micro-batch legality and world-size divisibility.
Do not combine ref_log_prob repair with unrelated actor or rollout tuning.

training_memory_pressure.purpose: Repair genuine actor training memory pressure in update_actor.
required_evidence: Use this strategy only when update_actor failed with OOM, the measured training peak reaches the active stage memory limit, or the memory estimator training upper_bound_pct crosses that limit with elevated risk.
For MEMORY_HEADROOM_EXCEEDED, require training_substage=training or direct update_actor evidence.
insufficient_evidence: Training has the highest relative peak but remains comfortably below the active memory limit.
ordered_actions: When actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz is false, decrease actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu first while preserving backend-normalized PPO mini/micro divisibility.

Enable actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.sequence_parallel only when actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size is greater than one, long-sequence activation pressure is credible, and backend support is known.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size only when sharding headroom is needed and world-size divisibility remains valid.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size only as a later feasibility control when lower-overhead controls cannot fit training.
do_not: Do not treat actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu as authoritative when dynamic batching controls training.
Do not change actor topology without revalidating data-parallel size and PPO mini/micro batching.
Do not change fixed workload, recompute, offload, or other profile parameters.

low_gpu_utilization.purpose: Treat low sampled GPU utilization as a symptom to diagnose, not as proof that a larger batch or greater concurrency will improve throughput.
required_evidence: Use steady-state trial samples after warmup rather than live_gpu_snapshot.
Require the phase to contribute materially to time_per_step and have memory headroom.
Check for scheduling, CPU, Ray, data, phase-transition, and communication waiting before attributing low utilization to undersized GPU work.
Use paired trial history or binding-limit evidence whenever available.
insufficient_evidence: A low phase utilization mean by itself.
A phase being performance.time_bottleneck by itself.
A single low-utilization sample or an idle live_gpu_snapshot.

rollout: Increase actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_batched_tokens only when the current token cap is reached, pending token work exists, and rollout memory has headroom.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_num_seqs only when the current sequence cap is reached, enough runnable requests exist, and rollout memory has headroom.
Increase actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization only when KV-cache capacity is binding; it is a memory budget, not a compute-utilization target.
Decrease actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size only when communication overhead is evidenced and the model plus KV cache remain memory-feasible.
actor_log_prob: When dynamic batching is disabled, increase actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu one valid step only when actor_log_prob memory has headroom.

Decrease actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size or actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size, or disable actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.sequence_parallel, only when communication overhead is evidenced and all affected actor_log_prob and training memory projections remain safe.
ref_log_prob: When dynamic batching is disabled, increase actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu one valid step only when ref_log_prob memory has headroom.

Decrease actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size or actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size, or disable actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.sequence_parallel, only when communication overhead is evidenced and ref_log_prob memory remains safe.
training: When dynamic batching is disabled, increase actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu one valid divisibility step only when training memory has headroom.

Decrease actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size or actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size, or disable actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.sequence_parallel, only when communication overhead is evidenced and both training and actor_log_prob memory remain safe.

do_not: Do not modify more than one phase family unless the extra changes are mandatory topology or divisibility dependencies.
Do not raise multiple rollout capacity ceilings speculatively when no ceiling is known to be binding.
If no allowed parameter has actionable evidence, keep the current configuration instead of forcing a change.

communication_bottleneck.purpose: Reduce demonstrated communication overhead while preserving memory feasibility and legal topology.
required_evidence: Require NCCL/BKCL or distributed timing evidence, a relevant log excerpt, or paired trials showing that greater sharding reduced end-to-end throughput.
Identify whether the evidence belongs to rollout, actor_log_prob, ref_log_prob, or training before changing topology.
insufficient_evidence: High TP or PP by itself.
A generic NCCL/BKCL failure without evidence that a legal topology change addresses it.
ordered_actions: For rollout, test a smaller actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size only when rollout memory remains safe.

For actor_log_prob or training, test smaller actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size or actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size only when both actor phases remain safe.
For ref_log_prob, test smaller actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.tensor_model_parallel_size or actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.pipeline_model_parallel_size only when ref memory remains safe.

Disable the phase's actor_rollout_ref.actor.megatron.sequence_parallel or actor_rollout_ref.ref.megatron.sequence_parallel only when its collective cost is evidenced and activation memory has headroom.
After actor topology changes, revalidate data-parallel size and PPO mini/micro batching; after ref topology changes, revalidate ref micro-batch legality.
do_not: Do not change actor, rollout, and ref layouts together in one trial.
Do not treat backend environment tuning as an LLM-adjustable parameter.
Do not accept an isolated phase improvement that lowers end-to-end throughput.

end_to_end_throughput.purpose: Choose the most actionable hardware hypothesis for end-to-end throughput rather than automatically optimizing the longest or highest-memory phase.
required_evidence: Use a feasible reference trial with steady-state throughput, time_per_step, phase durations, phase GPU utilization, and phase memory after warmup.
Keep workload and profile parameters fixed so trials remain comparable.
Use relevant paired trial history when it exists.
phase_selection: Estimate each phase's contribution to time_per_step.
For each phase, check whether an allowed parameter is demonstrably binding, undersized, communication-heavy, or memory-constrained.
Rank hypotheses by expected end-to-end gain, evidence quality, memory safety, and reversibility; the longest phase is only a prioritization signal.
Choose the best actionable hypothesis even when it belongs to the second-longest phase.
Keep the current configuration when no allowed parameter has sufficient evidence.
change_policy: max_parameter_changes is a hard safety ceiling, not a target.
Use one causal hypothesis and one phase family per trial.
Use the smallest sufficient change set; multiple parameters are appropriate only for mandatory topology, divisibility, or scheduler coupling.
Check all four memory-estimator upper bounds and risks before accepting a hardware candidate.
acceptance: Judge the real trial by end-to-end throughput and time_per_step under the fixed workload.
Reject a local phase win that reduces end-to-end throughput or violates any phase memory limit.
Treat uncalibrated estimator effects as hypotheses requiring a short real trial.
do_not: Do not optimize performance.time_bottleneck solely because it is the longest phase.
Do not optimize resource.memory_bottleneck solely because it has the largest relative memory peak.
Do not mix unrelated actor, rollout, and ref changes to consume the configured change allowance.

evidence: actor PPO KL exceeds warning threshold
ordered_actions: Lower actor learning rate.
Increase KL loss coefficient conservatively when use_kl_loss is enabled.
Add warmup when instability occurs at the start of training.
Confirm over 50-100 updates; a few updates cannot establish RL stability.

evidence: recent reward slope is negative beyond threshold
reward and entropy/clip metrics show degeneration
ordered_actions: Lower learning rate first.
Inspect KL, entropy, pg_loss, and clipfrac together before changing KL or entropy controls.
Avoid changing hardware parameters during stability tuning.
Use one causal hypothesis per trial and preserve successful hardware settings.

platform_portability.purpose: Re-establish a measured hardware baseline after changing GPU family or runtime without turning platform-profile choices into tuning parameters.
required_evidence: GPU family, SMI command, communication backend, runtime allocator, or device memory capacity differs from the reference environment.
fixed_profile_actions: Select the platform environment script outside the LLM parameter space.
Use GPU_SMI only as a fixed command override.
Re-run a short resource gate on every hardware family before trusting old memory observations.
Do not transfer absolute memory percentages across devices with different capacity or runtime allocators.
do_not: Do not modify workload or profile parameters merely because the platform changed.
Do not reuse old phase-memory calibration until the new platform has produced a successful measured reference trial.
Do not infer a hardware-normal parameter direction from the platform name alone.
